Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This reocrded statement concerns the parking lot collision you
reported in Pearland. Before we begin, do you agree to have this conversation recorded?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pearland. I had just pulled into a row looking for a space near the
entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before impact?
A: I was backing out of a space slowly. I checked my mirror and saw nothing, but when I started to reverse, a vehicle
came around the end of the row from my right side.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving?
A: Maybe walking pace, a few miles an hour. I was barely moving.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Only for a second. It was moving faster than I expected for a parking lot, and I tapped the brake, but there wasn't
time to stop completely.
Q: Where did the two vehicles make contact?
A: The rear corner of my car hit the front passenger side of the other vehicle.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: My neck felt stiff and my lower back ached, but I thought it would pass. It got worse over the next day or two.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to a clinic and was diagnosed with a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've been doing physical
therapy twice a week.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm still having some stiffness, so I'd like to keep my medical records updated for you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
